nate: quick check — our GH Action -> Atlantis apply -> ArgoCD post-apply webhook is intermittently returning 502/504s and causing ArgoCD to show sync failed. Anyone seen this? noticed after we added post-apply hook to call /api/webhook/v1/sync
taylor: saw something similar last month. often ingress timeout or argocd-server saturation. can you paste the GHA log snippet for the failing request? :eyes:
nate: log extract: `POST https://argocd.company.com/api/webhook/v1/sync` -> `502 Bad Gateway` (no response body). first attempt sometimes succeeds, retries fail.
sre-bot: alert: argocd-server pod argocd-server-6f7d4 reported 502 at 2025-09-05T14:12:30Z — high 95th pct latency.
jamie: a few routes: (1) increase LB/ingress timeout, (2) add client-side retries/backoff in the GH Action, (3) have Atlantis trigger argocd CLI instead of webhook. which is easiest short-term?
alex: CLI route is more deterministic — GH runner or Atlantis post-apply step runs `argocd app sync` with token. example step to run from gha runner:
```
- name: ArgoCD sync
  run: |
    argocd login argocd.company.com --token ${{ secrets.ARGOCD_TOKEN }} --insecure
    argocd app sync my-app --timeout 300
```
note: ensure `ARGOCD_TOKEN` is a service account token scoped correctly and masked in logs.
maria: also consider idempotency and prune behavior. if the webhook triggers a sync at the same time as another operation, we can get conflicts. `--prune=false` for critical apps if you want to avoid transient deletes during racing reconciles.
taylor: if you want to keep webhook, simplest quick fix is GH Action retry with exponential backoff. pseudo-step:
```
- name: Call argocd webhook (with retry)
  uses: jakejarvis/retry-action@v1
  with:
    retries: 4
    command: curl -fsS -X POST "$ARGOCD_WEBHOOK"
```
this avoids changing infra immediately.
nate: action plan: (1) i'll inspect argocd-server pod logs / CPU throttling and check ingress timeouts today, (2) i'll add a retry wrapper in the gha webhook step as a stop-gap, (3) we'll evaluate switching to `argocd` CLI from Atlantis if the webhook reliability doesn't improve. i'll post findings here tomorrow. :thumbsup:
jamie: sgtm, thanks for driving this
alex: if you go CLI route i can help create a least-priv SA + token and show how to store it in repo secrets
maria: and i'll add a quick Grafana panel for webhook latency so we have a signal before alerts fire
